items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: the wonderful old saying of Joe E. Lewis the great comedian, he said, 'I see a lot of old drunks around, but I don't see any old doctors around.'

ctx.x: You see, he was another guy who -- it's so silly really to talk about -- I am speaking of myself -- to talk about why people die, because you can be the healthiest person -- the old remark, here today, gone tomorrow -- you can be the healthiest person in the world and then be gone, I think perhaps longevity of life is inherited. There is something in the genes, because I have known people --

When you think of what Eddie Condon did to his body and yet managed to lived all those years. When you think of old drunks, for instance, the wonderful old saying of Joe E. Lewis the great comedian, he said, 'I see a lot of old drunks around, but I don't see any old doctors around.'
